# SpaPlus

SpaPlus is building a global platform for discovering, comparing and booking spa and wellness experiences.

## Official websites

- SpaPlus Global: https://spaplus.co/
- SpaPlus Canada: https://spaplus.ca/

## Ontario launch

SpaPlus is preparing for a future launch in Ontario, Canada. The launch date has not been announced.

Established spa businesses may join the early-access list. Registration is free, requires no credit card and does not create a commitment.

- English: https://app.spaplus.co/en-ca/ontario/
- Canadian French: https://app.spaplus.co/fr-ca/ontario/

## Priority Ontario areas

- Toronto
- Greater Toronto Area
- Niagara
- Ottawa
- Muskoka
- Hamilton

Each area has a dedicated English and Canadian French page under the Ontario launch section.

## Important accuracy notes

The Ontario launch artwork is illustrative and does not depict an Ontario spa or partner.

The Quebec spa examples shown on the Ontario launch page are reference examples from the existing SpaPlus Canada website. They are not presented as Ontario partners.

No Ontario spa inventory or booking availability is represented as live before the market launches.

## Contact

Spa businesses can use the registration form on the relevant Ontario or regional page. The SpaPlus team reviews submissions and aims to respond within 72 hours.
